basic_info.description: Thoughtfully reimagined Lake Shore home with timeless character, a friendly floor plan, inviting outdoor space and upgrades in all the right places. Designed for comfort and renovated with love and care, you can move right in and enjoy effortlessly! Formal living room with fireplace, elegant formal dining room, fully equipped kitchen, skylights, hardwood floors and classic period details. 2 spacious bedrooms and 1 full bath on the main level. Lower-level primary has en suite bath with dual sinks and oversized walk-in closet plus family room with direct access to an inviting and private garden. Laundry area, ample storage, one-car garage parking + additional driveway space. Upgraded plumbing and electrical systems. New tankless water heater and high-efficiency furnace. Ideal location near Ocean Beach, Stern Grove, Lake Merced, the SF Zoo, and Rolph Nicol Jr. Playground. Convenient access to MUNI, I-280 and 19th Avenue. Lakeshore Plaza, Stonestown Galleria, SF State University, Lowell High School and the West Portal shopping district are all practically next door
